name: oracle
description: Reads the room after every turn and deals three next moves — one sharp, one sideways, one past the edge — grounded in what just happened, what your repo holds, and what you actually pick.

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: fork: ask the session's own model over the live transcript (sharpest, reads the whole room, cheap while the cache is warm). fast: a small model fed a digest.

wildness.title: Wildness
wildness.description: How far the SIDEWAYS and EDGE lanes are allowed to lean.

voice.title: Voice
voice.default: direct, witty, a little dark, zero cheerleading

fastModel.title: Fast model
fastModel.description: Model alias or id for the fast engine and for cold opens.

auto.title: Deal automatically
auto.description: Deal a hand after every turn and at session start. Off: only /next deals.
